# Looponics — Technology Services Agency

> Looponics is a modern technology studio and software engineering agency designing and engineering high-impact digital products, intelligent systems, and custom software solutions.

## Overview
Looponics combines full-stack software engineering, business process automation, and applied agentic AI to help ambitious businesses and scaling teams move forward with confidence.

## Core Capabilities
- Web Development: Fast, responsive, accessible, full-stack digital experiences built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and modern cloud architecture.
- Mobile Application Development: Intuitive cross-platform iOS & Android mobile applications connecting users with reliable, high-performance digital products.
- AI-Powered SaaS Applications: Intelligent software products leveraging LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and scalable serverless backends.
- Custom Business Automations: End-to-end integration workflows connecting enterprise CRMs, payment processors, and databases to eliminate manual work.
- Agentic AI Systems: Autonomous and multi-agent systems designed to reason, coordinate tools, query live data, and execute complex business logic via APIs and MCP integrations.

## Engineering Process
1. Discover: Scoping business objectives, user requirements, and technical constraints before writing code.
2. Strategize: Architectural blueprint, technology stack selection, and milestone roadmap.
3. Design & Build: Iterative development cycles with continuous testing and deployment.
4. Deploy: Production launch, performance monitoring, continuous integration, and ongoing support.
